records.synonyms_note: Astragalus mexicanus A.DC. and Geoprumnon mexicanum (A.DC.) Rydb. are homotypic synonyms of this accepted variety.
records.concept_caution: Preserve variety rank under A. crassicarpus; do not create a duplicate species-level card or assume all A. crassicarpus observations belong to this variety.

records.synonyms_note: Hamosa leptocarpa (Torr. & A.Gray) Rydb. is homotypic; Astragalus nuttallianus var. leptocarpoides M.E.Jones is heterotypic under accepted A. leptocarpus.
